notes: Fixes the Empty Emergency Shell Cleanup control not appearing. The cleanup script previously loaded before the dynamically injected Shared Sync button existed and exited too early. It now waits for the Shared Sync dialog and attaches the repair control reliably. The repair remains limited to generic emergencyContact shells with no name, relationship, phone, email, address, language, or notes.
name: TEE v3.5.02 — Shell Cleanup Button Fix
